name: chain chausses
_design_note: F20-70 medium legs slot. Mail leg covering, traditionally paired with hauberk. Covers chain_leggings, iron_leggings, scale_greaves from legacy data.
lore_template: {material_name} chausses — chain mail leggings hanging from a belt at the waist and gathered at the ankle, traditionally paired with a full hauberk for unbroken coverage from collarbone to shin. The flexible weave permits a full stride and the deep kick of a stirruped cavalryman, while turning aside almost any cut not aimed with intent.
